manual_image_review.note: All crops were inspected together. The place crops visibly emphasize the square; each collection preview depicts its actual member. The historical comparison discloses non-identical viewpoints, and the protest photo does not identify participants or claim effect.

correctness_and_evidence.note: Nine content/geodata sources and four inspectable image pages support dates, roles, rules, protest sequence and evidence limits.

coverage_and_completion.note: Four image-ready collections, ten milestones, six terms, four Stories, four reading tracks, before/now, current note and an 8×7 quiz are materialized.

editorial_quality.note: Arena/organ, access/endorsement, visibility/representativeness, protest/decision and photograph/effect are distinguished.

technical_integrity.note: Deterministic finalizer, manifests, local assets, Politics report, v4.2 packet, runtime path and permanent test are included.

safety_and_responsibility.note: No participant identification, protest surveillance, representativeness overclaim or unsafe field task; observations stay in public areas.

maintainability_and_auditability.note: Claims, sentence mapping, source registry, image provenance, legacy audit, holdbacks and rejected overclaims form a reproducible trail.
